Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat

Class DcatDocumentFormatter

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.DcatDocumentFormatter
public class DcatDocumentFormatter extends Object
DcatDocumentFormatter reads and writes DCAT documents. The documents are in JSON-LD format, which is the serialization of DCAT that is also valid JSON. Any arrangement of a JSON-LD document can be read (nested, flattened, with prefixes or with full IRIs). Documents written by this class embed their context and nest the description of a dataset's distributions, publisher and contact points inside the dataset. The class is stateless and its methods are thread-safe. Parsing problems are reported as IOException so that callers do not need the Jackson libraries on their classpath.
